entries.reason: `IF VE-RESP = EIBRESP AND VE-RESP = WS-RESP` ELSE arm: LS-EIB is based on the pointer ADDRESS EIB returns, the task's own EIB storage, so VE-RESP is EIBRESP; EIBRESP is the response of the READQ TD just issued, which is also what RESP(WS-RESP) returns. Equal on every run for any queue state.

`IF WS-PTR-X = X'FF000000'` ELSE (PRESENT) arm: NONE-PARA is reached only by transaction mode N, which starts with no COMMAREA (EIBCALEN 0), and ADDRESS COMMAREA then returns IBM's X'FF000000' on every run. A COMMAREA is present only through LINK-PARA, which does not run NONE-PARA.
`IF VE-CALEN = EIBCALEN` ELSE arm: LS-EIB is based on the pointer ADDRESS EIB returns, the task own EIB storage, so VE-CALEN is the storage EIBCALEN names. Equal on every run for any COMMAREA length.
